items.name: Alchemy Factory
items.desc: Start small, team up with friends, and automate production with conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices. Stock your shop with potions, jewelry, and relics, complete commissions, and build an alchemy empire! Alchemy Factory 1.0 is out now with the Wagon Logistics System and revamped shopkeeping.

items.name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
items.desc: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library! is a single-player simulation. You need return scattered books to proper places in an Arcane Library. As completed rows of bookshelves, you can learn ability to improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to shelve 3,072 books as quick as you can.

items.name: Godius Eternal War
items.desc: A classic 2D pixel MMORPG inspired by the golden age of online RPGs. Join nation wars, explore an open multiplayer world, trade with players, battle in PvP, and experience a community-driven adventure that has continued since 1999.

items.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
items.desc: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

items.name: Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost
items.desc: "The collapse of Gensokyo... it was all you - " To rebuild the now barren phantasia, Reimu's journey begins. A Touhou Project officially approved derivative rhythm action game.

items.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
items.desc: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

items.name: Rift of the NecroDancer
items.sub: Brace Yourself Games · Rhythm, Minigames, Female Protagonist
items.desc: The NecroDancer's back in an all-new rhythm game! Dragged into a strange new world, Cadence must engage in musical combat with monsters surging through the Rift! Face pulse-pounding Rhythm Rifts where every beat is a battle, all set to an original soundtrack by Danny Baranowsky & friends.

items.name: Monster Hatcher
items.desc: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

items.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
items.desc: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

items.name: CHECKBORNE - A CHESS ADVENTURE
items.desc: Challenge 20 chess masters from around the world to duels across the board. Defeat them one by one, prove your skills, and fight your way to the top to become the ultimate CHECKBORNE Champion.

items.name: Willy and Charlie: Solitaire
items.desc: In *Willy and Charlie: Solitaire*, players journey through evolving challenges, building powerful decks and using strategy with a touch of luck to defeat opponents. Each match is unique—narrow wins or perfect chains can swing outcomes dramatically.

items.name: Stellar Forge
items.desc: You start with cold hydrogen and a dead clump of dust. Feed it, and the mix decides what ignites — 21 kinds of star, dwarf and collapsed body, none of them picked off a menu. Then send what you made into the ring with a God riding it, and knock rival bodies out of orbit.

items.name: Feeding Gooble
items.sub: Displacer Labs LLC · Casual, Strategy, Early Access
items.desc: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

items.name: SwapHeads!
items.sub: うさうさはっぴーげーむず · Action, Early Access
items.desc: A failed experiment has caused your heads to get swapped!? Control your buddy’s body from your own point of view in this unique 3D platform action game for two players,. Your bond with your buddy will be put to the ultimate test!?
